newsitem.title: USA: CME hogs seen steady to off, pork bellies higher.
newsitem.headline: CME hogs seen steady to off, pork bellies higher.

text.p: CME hog futures were expected to open steady to 0.200 cent a lb lower and pork bellies were called 0.200 to 0.500 cent higher, livestock analysts said.

Mixed but mostly lower cash hog indications on talk of somewhat larger hog runs were expected to weigh on hog futures early. The outlook for seasonally increasing hog marketings and news from some packers that they have cut back on kill rates could add to pressure, analysts said.
Reports that Japan will keep high tariffs on pork imports into the fall due to a large increase in January imports could also weigh on the market, sources added.
